value_cards.title: Integrity
value_cards.text: Full document disclosure before any payment. No hidden commission, ever.

value_cards.title: Quality
value_cards.text: Specified materials, tested concrete and workmanship we are willing to warrant.

value_cards.title: Reliability
value_cards.text: Agreed timelines with weekly progress reporting, and honesty when something slips.

value_cards.title: Partnership
value_cards.text: One dedicated advisor per client, from first site visit to long after handover.

service_cards.title: Residential Construction
service_cards.text: Family homes, duplexes and bungalows built to approved drawings with quality-checked materials.

service_cards.title: Commercial Construction
service_cards.text: Office blocks, showrooms and mixed-use buildings designed around rentable floor area.

service_cards.title: Turnkey Construction
service_cards.text: One contract covering design, permit, structure, finishing and handover — you receive the keys.

service_cards.title: Construction Contract
service_cards.text: Labour-only or material-and-labour contracts with itemised BOQ and staged billing.

service_cards.title: House Map / Drawing
service_cards.text: Complete working drawings — plans, elevations, sections and detail drawings ready for the municipality and the site.

service_cards.title: Architectural Design
service_cards.text: Layouts planned around light, ventilation and your family's daily routine, with 3D views before anything is finalised.

service_cards.title: Structural Design
service_cards.text: Earthquake-resistant RCC design with full analysis, reinforcement detailing and a signed structural report.

service_cards.title: Estimate & BOQ
service_cards.text: Item-wise bill of quantities and rate analysis, so you know the real cost before committing to a contractor.

service_cards.title: Building Permit Consultancy
service_cards.text: Document preparation, submission and follow-up until the municipal building permit is issued.

service_cards.title: Site Supervision
service_cards.text: Scheduled site visits checking steel, concrete, levels and workmanship, with a written report each time.

service_cards.title: Engineering Consultancy
service_cards.text: Second-opinion reviews, feasibility studies, soil test coordination, retrofitting advice and valuation reports for banks and buyers.

service_cards.title: Land Valuation
service_cards.text: Independent land and building valuation based on recent transactions, road access, zoning and development potential.

value_cards.title: Planned Road Network
value_cards.text: 13 – 20 ft blacktopped internal roads with proper turning space.

value_cards.title: Drainage & Water
value_cards.text: Underground drainage lines and a water supply connection at every plot boundary.

value_cards.title: Electricity
value_cards.text: Transformer installed and poles laid along all internal roads.

value_cards.title: Clear Documents
value_cards.text: Individual Lalpurja per plot, ready for immediate transfer at the Land Revenue Office.

contact_cards.title: Office Hours
contact_cards.text: Sunday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PMSaturday: Closed (site visits by appointment)
